split_rule: Random shot-level partition of a common pool: Train 5,828 shots, Validation 728 shots / 21,147 slices, Test 730 shots / 21,350 slices. Shot partitions are disjoint. Training fractions are nested shot subsets (1 < 5 < 10 < 25 < 50 < 100%). Scratch uses max500 epochs; fine-tuning uses max150 with 10% warmup.

phase_composition.train: All slices from the shot subset assigned to each training fraction; Validation slices are not training samples.

notes: Run manifests subset_run_real_{f}pct include the full Validation partition for validation windows; only Train rows are used for optimization.
